title: SetErrorType lacks Display impl — error messages are opaque to users
description: backend.rs:100-150 — SetErrorType is a user-visible type (it appears in JMAP error responses). It derives Debug but has no Display. A backend developer trying to log 'why did this create fail?' gets 'InvalidProperties' from {:?} but no natural .to_string() for log lines or error chain messages. Implement Display with human-readable descriptions matching the RFC error type names.
